messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "symptoms may occur with or without using medication"
set: ["symptoms may occur with or without using medication", "may be taken with or without food", "breathing problems may occur with overdose", "seizures may occur with abrupt discontinuation", "others may occur", "with or without food", "conditions can occur without warning", "do not stop using asthma medication without doctor's advice", "these symptoms may occur while you take this medicine", "some forms may be taken with or without food", "nausea with or without vomiting", "take with or without food", "call doctor if liver symptoms occur", "blood tests if liver symptoms occur", "child or other person using medicine without prescription", "read medication guide or patient instructions provided with each medication"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
